summary: Build a practical vendor management office setup with scorecards, governance, risk controls, and reporting templates. Enroll to learn the framework.
lede: Vendor coordination training covers how to structure supplier governance, oversight, and performance monitoring. Designed for professionals who manage suppliers, outsourced services, or vendor risk, it develops practical skills in setting decision rights, assessing supplier risk, and creating performance scorecards and escalation paths. Participants also work on onboarding and due-diligence processes and prepare reporting to support oversight and continuous improvement.
audienceIntro: This training is designed for professionals who manage suppliers, oversee outsourced services, or support vendor risk and performance reporting. It is especially relevant if you need to set up a vendor management office that works across procurement, operations, compliance, finance, and service delivery.
prerequisites: You need a laptop with spreadsheet software and access to presentation tools for workshop exercises. Familiarity with supplier records, contracts, SLA reports, or vendor issue logs will help you complete the applied tasks faster.
